{{Top|leg}}
A '''Redirection crystal''' was a device used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] assassination teams, as well as [[Drend Navett]]'s [[Vengeance (organization)|Vengeance]] cell. It was used with a [[blast tube]] to make it look like someone had fired a shot when the shooter hit the crystal behind them, making it look like a blast. The redirection crystal would be destroyed by the [[blast tube]] in the process, making it impossible to prove it had been present. This tactic was especially effective when used in conjunction with the rare [[Nightstinger sporting blaster rifle|Xerrol Nightstinger]], a blaster rifle which fired an invisible bolt.
